# 04_Intros-and-Video (red style)

The moving pieces, all 3840 x 2160 (4K), 24 fps, H.264 with sound (AAC, 48 kHz), plus each soundtrack as a WAV. Intro A (pop, 2 s), B (type, 4 s), C (slow, 7 s), the animated title logo (5 s, on colour and as a transparent ProRes 4444 .mov), and a 10 s end card with room for two video suggestions and the channel icon. Every one ends on a still, held lockup.
